bio: In this elegant, contemporary-style setting, friendly waitstaff serve up food that is an interesting fusion of Peruvian and Asian cuisine. The four- or six-course omakase menu is highly recommended. Alternatively, there is a good range of à la carte dishes listed under four headings: Crudo, Gyoza & Crujiente, Caliente and Guarnición. Housed in Schweizerhof hotel, this restaurant is only open on winter evenings, presenting an authentic culinary experience using top-quality ingredients. Incidentally, la muña is a medicinal plant in the Andes that is said to help against altitude sickness....
